title: Tăng trưởng và tài nguyên · Agree / Disagree
prompt: Some people believe that requiring governments to limit material consumption even if economic growth slows should be a priority. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: Reducing material consumption can cut the environmental cost of repeated replacement, but abrupt limits may threaten jobs and restrict households still lacking essential goods. I support prioritising lower material use even at some cost to growth, provided policy protects essential consumption and helps workers move into viable alternative employment.

Lower material use can reduce environmental pressure beyond what recycling achieves. Longer product lifetimes reduce the need for extraction, manufacturing and repeated transport. A repairable washing machine can provide years of additional service without another manufacturing cycle. The objective is to provide the same useful service with fewer replacement cycles, rather than simply count a larger volume of material entering recycling bins. Keeping a washing machine in service reduces replacement demand, whereas denying a first essential appliance to a low-income household raises a different question of fairness.

Abrupt restrictions can threaten employment in industries that depend on high sales volumes. Firms built around frequent replacement purchases may respond to falling demand by cutting employment before workers can move elsewhere. An environmental gain can therefore create concentrated local losses, especially where the same industry supports many neighbouring businesses. Transition plans should support workers and distinguish essential consumption from avoidable waste. Worker support should connect declining activities with viable new roles, while exemptions for essential needs prevent a uniform consumption target from worsening deprivation. Progress should be measured by material use per useful service and by workers' transition prospects, rather than by lower sales figures alone.
Growth in replacement sales is a weak measure of welfare when durable products meet the same needs with less extraction; the transition remains defensible only if its costs are shared fairly.

Firms built around frequent replacement purchases may respond to falling demand by cutting employment before workers can move elsewhere. An environmental gain can therefore create concentrated local losses, especially where the same industry supports many neighbouring businesses. Transition plans should support workers and distinguish essential consumption from avoidable waste. Worker support should connect declining activities with viable new roles, while exemptions for essential needs prevent a uniform consumption target from worsening deprivation. Progress should be measured by material use per useful service and by workers' transition prospects, rather than by lower sales figures alone.
paragraphs.why: Giảm doanh số đột ngột làm lao động chịu chi phí chuyển đổi. Hỗ trợ chuyển nghề và phân biệt nhu cầu thiết yếu với thay mới tránh dùng mục tiêu môi trường để bỏ qua phân phối tổn thất.

review: Task Response: Kết luận phải giữ cùng mức độ đồng ý, không biến “có điều kiện” thành “luôn nên làm”. Đã xử lý phản biện “Abrupt restrictions can threaten employment in industries that depend on high sales volumes.” chưa?

Lexical Resource: dùng “product lifetimes” đúng nghĩa “thời gian sản phẩm tiếp tục đáp ứng được chức năng sử dụng”, không thay thuật ngữ chính xác bằng từ hoa mỹ?

options: Chỉ kể trải nghiệm cá nhân rồi kết luận chính sách luôn đúng.

Đề hỏi mức độ đồng ý với việc ưu tiên chính sách. Phải nêu rõ ủng hộ hay phản đối phiên bản đang được đề xuất và giới hạn cụ thể của lập trường, rồi dùng cơ chế và phản biện để bảo vệ mức độ đó. Hỗ trợ chuyển nghề và phân biệt nhu cầu thiết yếu với thay mới tránh dùng mục tiêu môi trường để bỏ qua phân phối tổn thất.
Liệt kê mọi kiến thức về chủ đề mà không cần trả lời câu lệnh.

options: The issue of requiring governments to limit material consumption even if economic growth slows is very important in modern society and has many different opinions.
I completely support requiring governments to limit material consumption even if economic growth slows in every circumstance, regardless of its consequences.
I support prioritising lower material use even at some cost to growth, provided policy protects essential consumption and helps workers move into viable alternative employment.

Thiết bị đầu tiên không dùng tài nguyên nên có thể bỏ hoàn toàn khỏi mọi đánh giá môi trường.
Trường hợp đầu giữ cùng tiện ích với ít vật liệu hơn, còn trường hợp sau có thể duy trì thiếu thốn thiết yếu.
